page.overview:
Who is Depherad Kolios?

Depherad Kolios is a wedding planner in Zadash. As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

Depherad is a half-elven woman with long blonde hair, very pale skin and dark eyes even in the sclera.

When Jester and Fjord met her, she was wearing a very well buttoned over suit with a sash that has many beads hanging from it.

Depherad met with Jester and Fjord in Zadash, asking them numerous questions and offering suggestions and alternatives regarding the couple's wedding plans. Throughout the process, the half-elf took notes, remaining impartial and professional no matter how unusual what she heard was; the only time she showed any nervousness was when Artagan showed up unexpectedly and began appearing and disappearing in the room while contributing to the plans. Despite everything, the meeting ended successfully.
